# Toronto Film Critics Association Award for Outstanding Supporting Performance in a Canadian Film

}}
The Toronto Film Critics Association Award for Outstanding Supporting Performance in a Canadian Film is one of the annual awards given by the Toronto Film Critics Association. It was presented for the first time in 2025, alongside a new award for Outstanding Lead Performance in a Canadian Film.
Prior to 2025, a single award for  Outstanding Performance in a Canadian Film was presented, inclusive of both lead and supporting performances.
